description:
Dataset change feed, newest first: data[] {changed_on, fact_id, country, category, change: added | updated | removed, old_value, new_value, source_url}. Use it to refresh caches or alert users when a fact changes, then fetch the current cited value (sources, license, confidence) with the matching tool, e.g. get_country_facts or check_entry_requirements. Entry rows: country is the destination, fact_id is entry:<passport>-><destination>.
Parameters: set since to the last changed_on you processed (inclusive: that day repeats). Filter by category and/or country; exactly limit rows means older ones were cut, so raise limit or narrow. Examples: {"since":"2026-10-01"}, {"since":"2026-10-01","category":"entry","country":"JP"}.
Read-only; keyless (free key or x402 lifts limits: https://citedtravel.com/pricing/); errors RFC 9457.

category.description: Only changes in this category (entry = visa/entry pilot). Omit for all.

country.description: Only changes for this country (for entry facts, the destination) as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code, case-insensitive (e.g. JP, jp or JPN). Names are not accepted: resolve them with resolve_country first.

limit.description: Maximum rows, newest first. Default 100; values are clamped to 1-500 (numeric strings are accepted).

since.description: Return changes on or after this date. Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: list_recent_changes

source_url.description: Main source of the fact. Fetch the fact with the matching tool for full citations and confidence.

dataset_version.description: Version of the dataset that answered.

anyOf.description: Only on error results (isError: true): RFC 9457 problem, e.g. unknown country, no data, key required, rate limited, sanctions block.
anyOf.title: Error (problem details)

anyOf.description: Only on error results (isError: true): x402 v2 payment requirements. Pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"].
anyOf.title: Error (x402 payment request)

title: Recent changes
